docs.title: Workout Journal
docs.text:
My running and cycling journal: each session's numbers, what went wrong, and what to fix next. Strava and Runna are encouraging; this journal is meant to be honest.

Sessions are analysed with Claude (using my Strava data) and written up here as short entries. The focus files are living documents that change as I improve.

docs.title: Running: Runna "New To Running" plan, week 7 of 8
docs.text:
1. Cadence: hold 148 spm for the whole run (currently ~146 in the main effort, up from ~138–140). Use a metronome or 148 BPM music.
  2. Effort cap: keep easy-run HR under 160, and under 165 late in the run. Walk 20–30 s if over 165.
  3. Pacing: never start faster than I finish. My default "own pace" is still too hard.

docs.title: Cycling: Zone 2 base on a restored 26" MTB
docs.text:
1. Weekly long ride: ~70 min in Zone 2 (125–154 bpm) and growing ~10 min/week, toward 90–120 min.
  2. Climb control: keep flyover and bridge peaks under ~155 by shifting down early and spinning.
  3. Keep hard rides rare: events are fine; don't let event effort (HR ~160+) become normal riding.

docs.title: Rules of thumb
docs.text:
• Running calories ≈ 1 kcal per kg per km; walking ≈ half that. For rides, kJ of work ≈ kcal.
  • Apple Watch/Strava running cadence can be per leg; steps per minute = value × 2.
  • Ignore GPS max-pace spikes.
  • Calorie estimates from Strava undercount on the MTB.

Not medical advice.

docs.title: Cycling focus
docs.text: Living document: update goals, mistakes and progress as they change. Last updated 2026-11-17.

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
• Lifelong cyclist. Rode a road bike in the US (Oct 2025 – Sep 2026, 38 rides, ~900 km).
  • Now riding a restored 26" mountain bike in Chennai (abandoned for 7 years). No plans for a road or hybrid bike for now.
  • Routes are limited by Chennai traffic and road options. Judge rides on effort and duration, not speed or distance.
  • HR zones (Strava): Z1 0–124 · Z2 125–154 · Z3 155–169 · Z4 170–184 · Z5 185+

docs.title: Active goals
docs.text: Goal Target Status Weekly long ride Zone 2, +~10 min/week toward 90–120 min 72 min at HR 140 on 11-14 ✅ Climb control Flyover and bridge peaks under ~155 Peaked at 169 on the Anna University flyover (11-14) Easy by default ~80% of rides easy (HR 125–150), ~20% hard Back on track since 11-07; 11-15 was a deliberate event

docs.title: Rules
docs.text:
• Easy rides: HR 125–150, and you can talk the whole time.
  • Shift down early on flyovers; spin, don't stand and push.
  • Pulling away from signals: spin up in an easy gear.
  • The day before a run: keep it 30–40 min and very easy.
  • Ride-then-run back to back ("brick" workouts) not yet. Runs need fresh legs.
  • Rides over 90 min: bring food (banana or dates). Red Bull isn't hydration; carry water.
  • Front and rear lights plus something reflective for early rides.

docs.title: Recurring mistakes (from US riding history)
docs.text:
1. Every ride at the same moderately hard effort. Average HR 158–165 for hours (45 km at 158, 61 km at 162 for 3+ hours). Too hard to build base, too easy to count as real intensity.
  2. Speed plateaued for a year. ~19–21 km/h in Oct 2025 and still ~19–20 in Sep 2026.
  3. Long gaps: one ride in Feb, nothing mid-May to Aug, then only 3 rides before moving.
  4. Rode while sick (St. Patrick's Day). Don't.
  5. Bike fit: back hurt on the new road bike. Check fit and saddle height on the MTB.

docs.title: What's improving
docs.text:
• First truly easy rides in my history: 11-07 (HR 131), 11-12 (HR 137, entirely Zone 2).
  • 11-14: 72 min at HR 140 with no decoupling (first half ~16.5 km/h at 142, second half ~15.7 at 138). First evidence of aerobic durability.
  • 11-15 event: 27 km at 19.8 km/h on the MTB at HR 162, matching old road-bike speeds at a similar HR (drafting likely helped).

docs.title: Bike notes (26" MTB)
docs.text:
• Lost the bottle cage on 11-12. Bolts are backing out. Check every bolt (stem, seatpost, saddle clamp, brakes, cage mounts) and use threadlocker. Replace the cage before long rides.
  • Saddle height: slight knee bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke.
  • Planned: slick tyres 26 × 1.25–1.5" (~32–38 mm), budget under ₹2k. Considering aero bars for longer road rides.
  • Calories: Strava undercounts the MTB. Estimate from power (kJ ≈ kcal) plus ~0–20%.

docs.title: Running focus
docs.text: Living document: update goals, mistakes and progress as they change. Last updated 2026-11-17.

docs.title: Context
docs.text:
• Back to running after 3+ years off. Following the Runna "New To Running" plan (week 7 of 8 as of 2026-11-17).
  • Aerobically fitter than a true beginner (lifelong cyclist), but legs and calves aren't adapted to impact yet. Classic cyclist-turned-runner trap: the engine outruns the chassis.
  • Apple Watch VO2 max estimate ~31 (Nov 2026). Low for age; should rise quickly with consistent easy running.
  • HR zones (Strava): Z1 0–124 · Z2 125–154 · Z3 155–169 · Z4 170–184 · Z5 185+

docs.title: Active goals
docs.text: Goal Target Status Cadence 148 spm for the whole run ~146 in the main 3 km on 11-17 (was ~138–140). Close Easy-run HR Under 160; under 165 late in the run Drifting to 165–170 in the final km Pacing Never start faster than I finish Fixed in reps; "own pace" runs still too hard

docs.title: Rules for easy runs
docs.text:
• Conversational pace means HR, not pace. Slow down or walk to stay under the cap.
  • Make the first rep or km the slowest.
  • At 2 km into continuous runs: if HR is above 158, shorten stride and drop 20–30 s/km.
  • If HR goes over 165: walk 20–30 s, then continue.
  • Short, quick steps landing under the hips (~60 cm steps at ~11:00–11:40/km).
  • Running home after the session: walk it, or jog at the same easy pace.
  • Drink before runs; stash a bottle on the loop on hot or humid days.

docs.title: Recurring mistakes
docs.text:
1. Default pace is too fast. With no target, I settle at ~9:00–10:30/km and HR climbs into the 170s–180s (11-03, 11-04, 11-06, the 11-17 run home).
  2. Rep 1 faster than rep 2. Better since 11-11, but crept back on 11-13 (11:06 → 11:39).
  3. HR drift in the last km. Steady pace, but HR rises ~20–25 bpm (11-11, 11-17). Partly heat and humidity, partly fitness.
  4. Cadence matched to the slow beat. 140 BPM dubstep pulled cadence to ~140; switched to a metronome at 148.

docs.title: What's improving
docs.text:
• Average HR on easy sessions: 164 (11-06) → 145 (11-11) → 142 (11-13) → 152 over a longer continuous 3 km (11-17).
  • Time in Z4+: ~21 min (11-06) → 5 s (11-11) → 0 (11-13).
  • Continuous running: 2 km at HR 162 / max 184 (11-03) → 3 km at HR 152 / max 171 (11-17).
  • Cadence: ~138–140 → ~146 in the main effort (11-17).

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• Calves got sore on 11-06. Doing calf raises (3 × 15, three times a week). Stop running for sharp or localized pain.
  • Whey protein after runs is fine; rehydrate separately with water and electrolytes.
  • Form metrics (ground contact ~330–345 ms, vertical oscillation ~9.5–10.5 cm) should improve as cadence rises. Watch the trend, not single runs.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text:
Metric Rep 1 Rep 2 Pace ~9:00/km ~10:45/km Avg HR 156 176 Max HR 173 187 Cadence ~142 spm ~136 spm
  • Avg HR during the walk break before rep 2: ~175 (no recovery)
  • Perceived effort 7/10 · Relative Effort 82

docs.text: Classic fade. Went out too fast, then rep 2 was slower at a much higher HR.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• Rep 1 at my default ~9:00/km.
  • Started rep 2 already near my limit.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text: • Start rep 1 at 10:30–11:00/km. Rep 2 should match or beat it.

docs.text:
Plan: Runna week 5. 5 min walk, 2 × 1.75 km at conversational pace with 90 s walks, 5 min walk.

Conditions: 25.9°C, 92% humidity.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text: Metric Value Distance 4.55 km Rep 1 / Rep 2 pace 9:19 → 11:05 /km Avg HR / Max HR 164 / 192 Zones Z4 37% (19:27), Z5 4% (2:01) Cadence ~140 spm while running (125 overall) Ground contact ~340–360 ms while running Vertical oscillation ~10 cm Relative Effort 122 Calories 279 (Strava)

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: An easy session done hard: ~21 min in Z4–5 at 9–11 min/km. HR rose in rep 2 while pace fell.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• Rep 1 too fast (first km briefly near 8:00/km).
  • Low cadence and long ground contact: heavy, bouncy, overstriding.
  • Calves got sore during the run.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• Cap rep HR at 160; walk if over 165.
  • Shorter, quicker steps (aim 145–148 spm).
  • Calf raises 3× a week.

docs.title: 2026-11-11 · Run · 2 × 2 km
docs.text:
Plan: Runna week 6. 5 min walk, 2 × 2 km at conversational pace with 60 s walks, 5 min walk.

Conditions: 27°C, 80% humidity. Music: 140–150 BPM dubstep.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text:
Metric Rep 1 Rep 2 Pace ~11:51/km ~11:36/km Avg HR 136 162 Max HR 157 175 Cadence (lap avg) ~134 spm ~140 spm
  • Session avg HR 145 · Z4 only 5 s · Relative Effort 62 (vs 122 on 11-06)
  • Calories 293 (Strava); ~260 active estimated
  • Forgot to stop the watch: ~6 min of sitting at the end

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: Pacing fixed. More distance for half the strain, and rep 2 faster than rep 1.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• Rep 2 drifted over the cap (avg 162, max 175).
  • Cadence unchanged; matched the half-time beat of 140 BPM tracks.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• Ease off in the final km of rep 2, or walk 20–30 s when over 165.
  • Use 148 BPM tracks or a metronome.

docs.text:
Plan: Runna week 6. 5 min walk, 2 × 2 km at conversational pace with 60 s walks, 5 min walk.

Conditions: 25.6°C, 88% humidity.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text:
Metric Rep 1 Rep 2 Pace ~11:06/km ~11:39/km Avg HR 140 157 Max HR 162 170 Cadence (lap avg) ~138 spm ~140 spm
  • Session avg HR 142 · Max 170 · Z4 0 s · Relative Effort 56
  • ~80 s stop mid-rep 2
  • Completed week 6

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: Rep 1 ~45 s/km faster than on 11-11 for +4 bpm; rep 2 same pace at −5 bpm. The aerobic trend is real. Cadence hasn't moved.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• Rep 1 started too fast again (spiked to ~9:30/km near 2 km); rep 1 faster than rep 2.
  • Cadence stuck at ~138–140.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• One full rep with a 148 metronome, no music.
  • Rep 1 must be the slower rep.

docs.title: 2026-11-14 · Ride · First medium-distance ride in Chennai
docs.text:
Plan: Weekly long ride, Zone 2.

Conditions: 24.6°C, 89% humidity. Fasted, with one can of Red Bull.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text: Metric Value Distance / time 20.3 km / 72 min moving Avg speed 17.0 km/h Avg HR / Max HR 140 / 169 1st half / 2nd half ~16.5 km/h @ 142 · ~15.7 km/h @ 138 Anna University flyover (3%) avg HR 157 Relative Effort 54 Calories 367 (Strava), ~500–625 estimated

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: Best base ride yet. Twice the distance of 11-12 at nearly the same HR, and no decoupling over 70+ min.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• HR spiked to 169 on flyover climbs.
  • Regular Red Bull = ~110 kcal of sugar, so not really fasted. Not hydration either.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• Shift down early on flyovers; keep peaks under 155.
  • Carry water. For rides over 90 min, bring food.
  • Make this the weekly long ride; +10 min each week.

docs.title: 2026-11-15 · Ride · Race against Diabetes – Thooral 25
docs.text:
Plan: Organised charity ride (event), Pallavaram.

Conditions: 25°C, 91% humidity. Context: event, likely drafting, few stops.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text: Metric Value Distance / time 27.1 km / 82 min moving Avg speed 19.8 km/h Avg HR / Max HR 162 / 182 1st half / 2nd half ~19.5 km/h @ 160 · ~19.3 km/h @ 162 Relative Effort 179 Calories 625 (Strava), ~700–750 estimated

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: Hard and very evenly paced. Matched old road-bike speeds (~20 km/h at HR 158–165) on a heavy MTB. Longest and fastest Chennai ride.

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• Upper Zone 3 for 80 min: the same effort that kept my US speed flat for a year. Fine for an event, not as a habit.
  • Back to back with the 72-min ride the day before; no easy day between.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• Rest or a very easy spin the next day.
  • Keep the next run strictly conversational, even if HR runs higher than usual.

docs.title: 2026-11-17 · Run · Continuous 3 km
docs.text:
Plan: Runna week 7. 5 min walk, 3 km continuous at conversational pace, 5 min walk.

Conditions: Two days after a hard event ride.

docs.title: Numbers
docs.text: Metric Value Main 3 km ~11:38/km Avg HR / Max HR (3 km) 152 / 171 HR by km ~137–147 → 153–156 → 163–170 Cadence ~146 spm in the per-second data (142 lap avg) Extra after cool-down ~640 m at ~10:30/km, HR up to 180 (running home) Relative Effort 60

docs.title: Verdict
docs.text: First continuous 3 km. 50% further than the 2 km on 11-03, with average HR 10 bpm lower. Cadence finally moving (~146).

docs.title: What went wrong
docs.text:
• HR drifted ~25 bpm at steady pace; last 500 m over the 165 cap.
  • The unplanned run home at "own pace" hit 180. My default pace is still too hard.

docs.title: Fix for next time
docs.text:
• At 2 km: if HR is above 158, shorten stride and slow 20–30 s/km. Walk 20–30 s if over 165.
  • Walk home, or jog at the same easy pace.
  • Keep the metronome; push from 146 to 148.

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
• All three runs were done too hard. Avg HR 157–164, max up to 192, ~21 min in Z4–5 on 11-06.
  • Each run started at my default ~9:00/km and faded. Rep 2 was slower at a higher HR every time.
  • Relative Effort climbed 43 → 82 → 122 while distance only grew from 2 km to 3.5 km.
  • Bright spot: 11-07 was the first truly easy ride in my history (HR 131).
  • Calves got sore on 11-06.

docs.title: Goals set for next week
docs.text:
1. Cap easy-run HR at 160 (165 late); walk if over.
  2. Rep 1 no faster than rep 2.
  3. Cadence toward 148 (shorter, quicker steps).
  4. Rides: stay in Zone 2, build duration.

docs.title: Goal check
docs.text: Goal Result Easy-run HR ≤160 (165 late) ⚠️ Avg HR down to 142–145 and Z4 near zero, but rep 2 still peaked at 170–175 Rep 1 ≤ rep 2 ✅ 11-11 · ❌ 11-13 (11:06 → 11:39) Cadence → 148 ❌ Stuck at ~138–140 (dubstep half-time trap) Rides in Zone 2, building duration ✅ 40 min → 72 min, no decoupling

docs.title: Summary
docs.text:
• Biggest change of the block: same runs at ~20 bpm lower HR than week 45.
  • Week 6 of the Runna plan completed.
  • Rides: 11-12 entirely Zone 2; 11-14 was the best base ride yet (20 km at HR 140); 11-15 was a hard charity event (27 km at HR 162), evenly paced.
  • Lost the bottle cage on 11-12. Check the bike's bolts.

docs.title: Adjustments for next week
docs.text:
1. Cadence becomes the #1 running goal: use a metronome at 148 for full reps.
  2. Continuous runs: check HR at 2 km; slow down early rather than walk late.
  3. Recovery: no easy day between the 11-14 long ride and the 11-15 event. Take it easy into the next run.
  4. Long ride: aim for ~80 min in Zone 2; flyover peaks under 155.
